nodes.label: Longer Coach Replies Behavior
nodes.rationale: Feature: after each user turn, the AI Coach does not stop at correction/suggestion but extends the dialogue with 2-3 sentences derived from the user's last utterance, structured as react -> expand -> follow-up question. Implemented purely in the system prompt (SYSTEM_INSTRUCTION in constants.ts) so the app logic (parsing [Correction]/[Assessment]/[Insight] blocks, TTS on non-block text) is unchanged. The /translate mode is scoped to keep replies short. Verified by lint pass (tsc --noEmit) and manual OmniRoute /v1/chat/completions calls in daily and translate modes. Risk: model may break block format (insert [Correction] mid-speech or write the student turn itself); mitigation is the 'react and extend, then STOP' instruction plus the legacy 'STOP and WAIT' rule.
